version: v0.4-frozen (assets unchanged since v0.3; scope closed by OD-014)
purpose: Exact local font binaries used for every canonical PNG capture in reference/. No remote font request occurs during canonical capture.

licence.name: SIL Open Font License 1.1
licence.note: Same OFL 1.1 text governs Barlow and Barlow Semi Condensed. Retain the copyright notice and licence with any redistribution; reserved font names must not be used for modified versions.

subset.excluded: latin-ext, vietnamese — not used by any frozen copy string

files.upstream_version: Google Fonts Barlow Semi Condensed v16
Google Fonts Barlow Semi Condensed v16
Google Fonts Barlow Semi Condensed v16
Google Fonts Barlow Semi Condensed v16

fallback_stack.semi_condensed: 'Barlow Semi Condensed', 'Barlow', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

loading_behavior.canonical_capture: font-display:block; capture waits on document.fonts.ready before any PNG is taken, so no fallback frame is ever exported.
loading_behavior.production_guidance: font-display:swap with both families preloaded (<link rel=preload as=font type=font/woff2 crossorigin>). Metrics differ between Barlow and the Helvetica/Arial fallback; reserve line-box height via the fixed line-heights in tokens/pump-fiction.tokens.json rather than relying on font metrics.
loading_behavior.remote_dependency: none — no fonts.googleapis.com or fonts.gstatic.com request at runtime or at capture time.
